claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Salzburg's medieval Old Town, surrounded by shops displaying wrought iron guild signs.

findings.quote: The hotel is in the heart of the medieval old town, surrounded by shops displaying wrought iron guild signs.

claims.text: The historic Getreidegasse, a thoroughfare since Roman times, lies just outside the hotel.

findings.quote: Just outside the hotel, near Salzburg’s train station, lies the distinguished Getreidegasse – a historic thoroughfare since Roman times

claims.text: Mozart's birthplace is just a few steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Just a few steps from our hotel you will find Mozart's birthplace

claims.text: The Festival Hall is just across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: the famous Festival Hall is just across the street

claims.text: Salzburg's Old Town was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997.

findings.quote: Salzburg’s Old Town, named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997

claims.text: The rooms are elegant and traditionally furnished.

findings.quote: our elegant and traditionally furnished rooms

claims.text: Restaurant Herzl serves Austrian cuisine in a modern yet cozy atmosphere.

findings.quote: Restaurant Herzl offers pleasurable experiences in a modern yet cozy atmosphere. Enjoy a selection of exclusive culinary offers and discover Austria’s cuisine and its various facets.

claims.text: The hotel regularly hosts special culinary events at Restaurant Herzl and Bar Goldener Hirsch.

findings.quote: Discover the special events and exclusive offers we regularly host at Restaurant Herzl and Bar Goldener Hirsch.
Exceptional Culinary Events at Hotel Goldener Hirsch

claims.text: The hotel is child-friendly and welcomes guests of all ages.

findings.quote: the tradition-steeped and child-friendly Hotel Goldener Hirsch welcomes guests of all ages.

claims.text: Haus der Natur, a museum with exhibitions, a zoo area and science stations, is a stone's throw from the hotel.

findings.quote: Haus der Natur ("The House of Nature") is situated just a stone's throw away from the Hotel Goldener Hirsch.
Exciting exhibitions, a large zoo area and interactive science and technology stations

claims.text: The Toy Museum, known for its collection of antique toys, is just around the corner from the hotel.

findings.quote: The Toy Museum is famous for its collection of antique toys and is located just around the corner of Hotel Goldener Hirsch.

claims.text: When the Salzburg Festival took place for the first time in 1920, the hotel was the festival's first host.

findings.quote: When the Salzburg Festival took place for the first time in 1920, we were the Salzburg Festival's first host.

claims.text: The inn first welcomed guests in the 15th century.

findings.quote: this legendary inn, which first welcomed guests in the 15th-century

claims.text: The interiors feature vaulted ceilings, antique farmers' furniture and deer and stag heads, and staff wear lederhosen and dirndls.

findings.quote: the vaulted ceilings, antique farmers’ furniture, deer and stag heads, and staff in lederhosen and dirndls

claims.text: Hohensalzburg Fortress, Europe's largest castle complex, can be reached on foot from the hotel in ten minutes.

findings.quote: The Hohensalzburg Fortress, Europe’s largest castle complex located in the center of Salzburg, can be reached on foot in just ten minutes.

claims.text: Driving can be a hassle because of pedestrian-only areas and confusing road signs; Conde Nast Traveler suggests taking the train from Vienna or Munich.

findings.quote: Because driving can be a hassle—pedestrian-only areas, inscrutable road signs—you’re better off taking the train from Vienna or Munich.

claims.text: The hotel describes the Salzburg Festival weeks, held every year, as busy.

findings.quote: celebrate the busy Salzburg Festival weeks annually

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the historic building has limited modern amenities such as fitness facilities.
